Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Kevin Huerter?

Kevin Huerter is 27 years old.

Where was Kevin Huerter born?

Kevin Huerter was born in Albany, New York.

When was Kevin Huerter born?

Kevin Huerter was born on August 27, 1998.

How tall is Kevin Huerter?

Kevin Huerter is 6-6 (198 cm) tall.

How much does Kevin Huerter weigh?

Kevin Huerter weighs 198 lbs (89 kg).

Is Kevin Huerter in the Hall of Fame?

Kevin Huerter is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Kevin Huerter drafted?

Kevin Huerter was drafted by Atlanta Hawks, 1st round (19th pick, 19th overall), 2018 NBA Draft.

What position does Kevin Huerter play?

Shooting Guard and Small Forward.

What is Kevin Huerter's net worth?

Kevin Huerter has made at least $76,902,517 playing professional basketball.

How much does Kevin Huerter make?

Kevin Huerter made $17,991,071 in 2026.

How many rings does Kevin Huerter have?

Kevin Huerter has won 0 championships.

What is Kevin Huerter's Instagram account?

Kevin Huerter is on Instagram at kevin_huerter.

What schools did Kevin Huerter attend?

Kevin Huerter attended Shenendehowa Central in Clifton Park, New York and Maryland.

What are Kevin Huerter's nicknames?

K'Von, Red Mamba, Red Velvet, Headband Huerter are nicknames for Kevin Huerter.
